question: A 44-year-old female is admitted to the neurological service. You examine her chart and note that after admission she was started on nimodipine. Which of the following pathologies would benefit from this pharmacologic therapy?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Nimodipine -> calcium channel blocker -> used to prevent vasospasm -> Subarachnoid hemorrhage -> 90% CHAIN: Nimodipine -> inhibits calcium influx -> reduces cerebral vasospasm -> Subarachnoid hemorrhage -> 85% CHAIN: Nimodipine -> improves cerebral blood flow -> beneficial in vasospasm -> Subarachnoid hemorrhage -> 90%
analysis: Nimodipine is a calcium channel blocker that is commonly used in the management of subarachnoid hemorrhage. It helps to prevent and treat cerebral vasospasm, which can occur as a complication of subarachnoid hemorrhage.
